name: Oi Handsome!!
summary:
Kentaro Ito lives with his wife Chizuru in Tokyo. They have 3 daughters: Yuka, Rika, and Mika. All of three of their daughters have moved out and live on their own. Yuka is 28-years-old and single. Her career is going well, but, in her personal life, she tends to fall in love with married men. Rika is 25-years-old and she is married to a man, who works at a bank. They live in Osaka, but they are on the verge of getting a divorce. Mika is 22-years-old and single. She lives with her boyfriend. Her boyfriend aspires to become a manga writer, but his prospects don't look so good.

Kentaro Ito believes his daughters have terrible taste in men and he decides to introduce a man to his daughters.

name: Borgen - Riget, Magten og Æren
summary: Birgitte Nyborg is the newly appointed Minister of Foreign Affairs, when oil is suddenly found in Greenland. But Nyborg has gone to the polls on a green agenda, and for her there is no doubt that the oil project must be shut down as soon as possible. Voices in Greenland - led by the Greenlandic Minister, Hans Eliassen - are, however, of a completely different opinion.

name: Not Dead Yet
summary: Not Dead Yet follows Nell Serrano, broke, newly single and feeling old, a a self-described 40-something disaster, who works to restart the life and career she left behind 10 years ago. When she lands the only job she can find – writing obituaries – Nell starts getting life advice from an unlikely source.

name: Maya: Ancient Metropolis
summary: Using detailed and explanatory 3D recreations, re-enactments and interviews with leading international experts, this series brings the Maya civilisation back to life and reveals the mysteries of their greatest achievements: the first urban metropolises in the world.

name: Blood Money: Inside the Nazi Economy
summary: June 1940: Hitler launches tanks and troops across France, Belgium and Holland. Yet Germany is impoverished, has few raw materials, and no oil or currency. How did the Nazis manage to set off the cataclysm of WWII with little money and a weak economy? Based on the work of a new generation of French, British and German historians, our film takes an economic, industrial and financial approach to the Third Reich, exploring the inner workings of the Nazi system through key characters who have been overshadowed by history (Hjalmar Schacht, Dr. Georg Von Schnitzler, Fritz Sauckel, Erich Müller...). Thanks to 3D animation and rare archive footage, this film will reveal how the Nazis were able to weave their violent, racist views into every thread of the German economy, from large-scale industry to small businesses to agriculture, research and nance, creating a model whose main management tools were theft and mass murder, and whose ultimate goal was war and the destruction of Europe.

name: The First World War: The People's Story
summary: The First World War: The People's Story draws on an extraordinary and little known archive of two hundred interviews with the last survivors from the battlefields and the home front, filmed over the past twenty-five years. Vivid and heart breaking accounts are told from the main theatres of war - such as Passchendaele and the Somme - as well as on the home front where families were devastated by the loss of loved ones. One of the most catastrophic wars in human history is seen and heard as never before, as emotional testimonies are combined with digitally restored WWI footage to tell the people's story.

name: Operación Marea Negra
summary: Operación Marea Negra takes place in November 2019 and, based on real events, revolves around the plans of Augustín Álvarez, a fisherman and former Spanish amateur boxer promise, to traffic three tons of cocaine between Latin America and Europe.

name: Here We Go
summary:
Here We Go follows the highs and lows of the Jessop family as they navigate a combination of life's everyday challenges – changing careers, keeping the romance alive within a marriage, adopting a healthier lifestyle, kidnapping a dog, destroying a swimming pool and sabotaging a wedding.

Having filmed his family's disastrous attempt to carve out a holiday in the midst of the pandemic in the 2020 pilot episode, the series sees youngest son Sam continue to document the Jessop family across the year. Moving back and forward in time, each episode offers an intimate, observed and absurd exposé of a modern British family doing its best to support each other, if accidentally annoying everyone else in the process.

name: XO, Kitty
summary: A new love story unfolds when teen matchmaker Kitty reunites with her long-distance boyfriend at the same boarding school attended by her late mother.

name: My Pack Life
summary: Some say that a house is not a home without a dog - but what about 21 rescue dogs, 2 donkeys, some pigs, an alpaca, a goat... and a very awkward llama? For Lee Asher, it's not only another day in paradise, but it's a chance to take on the animals who are underdogs just like him and to show them the love, confidence, and stability they need to thrive in his Oregon-based sanctuary, The Asher House. Join Lee and his extended furry-family as he goes above and beyond to create a modern-day Noah's Ark through his sanctuary not only to provide a space for these animals, but to build a home and the best life imaginable for every animal in need.

name: Gordita Chronicles
summary: The Gordita Chronicles centers on Carlota "Cucu" Castelli, a willful 12-year-old Dominican immigrant with a heart of gold. Cucu leaves her home and her parochial school in Santo Domingo to live in Miami and pursue the American Dream during the hedonistic 1980s after her father, a marketing executive with a large airline, gets transferred there. Cucu meets head-on the challenges of being an immigrant in a strange new world with humor, bravado and some really bad choices.

name: A Man in Full
summary: When Atlanta real estate mogul Charlie Croker faces sudden bankruptcy, political and business interests collide as Charlie defends his empire from those attempting to capitalize on his fall from grace.

name: I Love That for You
summary: Inspired by true events, I Love That for You follows childhood leukemia survivor Joanna Gold as she chases her lifelong dream of becoming a home shopping channel host. Shedding her "cancer girl" label, she moves away from her parents, starts a budding romance for the first time in her adult life and befriends her idol, the charismatic star of the network. But when a little white lie to her boss turns into a big snowy avalanche, Joanna finds that living the dream comes with a hefty price tag.

name: The Brothers Sun
summary: When a mysterious enemy targets his family, a Taipei triad member heads to Los Angeles to protect his strong-willed mother and oblivious younger brother.

name: The Lost Flowers of Alice Hart
summary: The Lost Flowers of Alice Hart tells the compelling story of a young girl, Alice Hart, whose violent childhood casts a dark shadow over her adult life. After a family tragedy in which she loses both her abusive father and beloved mother in a mysterious fire, 9-year-old Alice is taken to live with her grandmother June on a flower farm, where she learns that there are secrets within secrets about her and her family's past. Set against Australia's breathtaking, natural landscape, and with native wildflowers and plants providing a way to express the inexpressible, this enthralling family drama spans decades, as Alice grows from a child into a woman. Her journey is epic and visceral, building to an emotional climax as Alice finds herself fighting for her life against a man she loves.

name: Up Here
summary: A musical romantic comedy set in New York City in the waning days of 1999, following the extraordinary story of one ordinary couple, as they fall in love - and discover that the single greatest obstacle to finding happiness together might just be themselves - and the treacherous world of memories, obsessions, fears, and fantasies that lives inside their heads.

name: Everything's Trash
summary: The series follows Phoebe, a 30-something podcast star navigating her messy life. Forced to grow up when her older brother Jayden emerges as a leading political candidate, she relies on her friends and close-knit family to help her figure out adulthood.

name: Uncoupled
summary: Uncoupled centers on Michael who thought his life was perfect until his husband blindsides him by walking out the door after 17 years. Overnight, Michael has to confront two nightmares - losing what he thought was his soulmate and suddenly finding himself a single gay man in his mid-forties in New York City.

name: Supacell
summary: Supacell follows a random group of ordinary people from South London who unexpectedly develop super powers, with no clear connection between them other than them all being black.

name: The Recruit
summary: The Recruit follows Owen Hendricks, a fledgling lawyer at the CIA who becomes enmeshed in dangerous international power politics when a former asset threatens to expose the agency.

name: My Life With the Walter Boys
summary: In the coming of age show, following the loss of her family in a tragic accident, 16-year old Manhattanite Jackie Howard has to learn to adapt to a new life in rural Colorado with her guardian – and 12 very rowdy kids.

name: Freeridge
summary: Four teen friends work to reverse a curse after a peculiar old box seems to bring misfortune — and more — into their lives.

name: Black Cake
summary: In the late 1960s, a runaway bride named Covey disappears into the surf off the coast of Jamaica and is feared drowned or a fugitive on the run for her husband's murder. Fifty years later in California, Eleanor Bennett, a widow in her 60s, loses her battle with cancer, leaving her two estranged children a flash drive that holds previously untold stories of her journey from the Caribbean to America. These stories, narrated by Eleanor, shock her children and challenge everything they thought they knew about their family's origin.

name: The Santa Clauses
summary: Scott Calvin is on the brink of his 65th birthday and realizing that he can't be Santa forever. He's starting to lose a step in his Santa duties, and more importantly, he's got a family who could benefit from a life in the normal world, especially his two kids who have grown up at the Pole. With a lot of elves, children, and family to please, Scott sets out to find a suitable replacement Santa while preparing his family for a new adventure in a life south of the pole.

name: Loot
summary: In Loot, billionaire Molly Novak has a dream life, complete with private jets, a sprawling mansion and a gigayacht — anything her heart desires. But when her husband of 20 years betrays her, she spirals publicly, becoming fuel for tabloid fodder. She's reaching rock bottom when she learns, to her surprise, that she has a charity foundation run by the no-nonsense Sofia Salinas, who pleads with Molly to stop generating bad press. With her devoted assistant Nicholas by her side, and with the help of Sofia and team — including mild-mannered accountant Arthur and her optimistic, pop-culture-loving cousin Howard — Molly embarks on a journey of self-discovery. Giving back to others might be what she needs to get back to herself.

name: Dunkirk: Mission Impossible
summary: Former Royal Marine JJ Chalmers uses his own devastating experiences of war to give his perspective on the evacuation of Allied soldiers in May and June 1940.

name: Inside Line
summary: Inside Line: A season with Walkinshaw Andretti United. A tale of redemption for the former Holden Racing team as they attempt to fight back after years of mediocrity with broad sweeping changes including 2 new drivers lead by star signing Chaz Mostert.

name: Emergency
summary: Stripped over four nights, this ground-breaking series tells the story of the London Major Trauma System. Set up in the wake of the London bombings of 2005, it's a unique interconnected network of hospitals, air ambulances and paramedics that provide a lifeline for 10 million people in London and the South-East. A system that has improved the chances of survival for major trauma patients by 50%. Filmed during the busiest month of last summer, the series follows the minute-by-minute decisions made by some of the country's top medics, as they treat the most critically injured patients.

name: Compulsion
summary: Compulsion follows paramedic Jenny, who after a fatal train crash develops a gambling addition to try to cope with her PTSD.  Heavily in debt to some dangerous people, help arrives in the form of a good Samaritan Sasha, who offers Jenny a way out. However, Sasha has her own agenda, one which will ultimately force Jenny to take the biggest gamble of her life. For her life.

name: Deadliest Kids
summary: Deadliest Kids explores cases of youngsters who have been convicted of murder across North America and Canada.

name: Le Gros Laboratoire
summary: Le Gros Laboratoire subjects 100 Quebec human guinea pigs to various scientific and often zany experiments to test various hypotheses and draw conclusions about human behaviour, including our reactions to fear, sex, humour, racism, money, and aging.

name: Huissiers
summary: Each year in Quebec, 450 bailiffs serve several deeds and collect thousands of dollars in debts. Behind every door is a human being and the bailiffs will have to listen, show empathy and thus find a way to resolve each situation. Huissiers plunges us into the world of these unloved and misunderstood legal professionals who find themselves first in front of offenders.

previousepisode.name: Quand la coopération est au rendez-vous

name: Bloom County
summary: Bloom County is a series based on the world, which centers on a collapsed lawyer, a lobotomized cat and a penguin in briefs and fruit headwear living in the world's last boarding house in the world's most forgotten place deep in the dandelion wilds of FlyWayWayOver country.

name: The Challenge: USA
summary: The Challenge: USA is a spinoff of the popular series that is part of a global tournament in which reality titans from the CBS universe will compete in the most unpredictable and demanding game of their lives.

name: Son Nefesime Kadar
summary: Son Nefesime Kadar tells the story of a woman who works as a commissioner in a small town, whose whole world is turned upside down when the man she thinks is responsible for her daughter's death is released from prison.

name: NCIS: Sydney
summary: With rising international tensions in the Indo-Pacific, a brilliant and eclectic team of U.S. NCIS agents and the Australian Federal Police (AFP) are grafted into a multinational taskforce to keep naval crimes in check in the most contested patch of ocean on the planet.

name: A Small Light
summary: A Small Light follows twenty-something Miep Gies who, when her boss Otto Frank came to her and asked her to hide his family from the Nazis during World War II, didn't hesitate. For the next two years, Miep, her husband Jan, and the other helpers watched over the eight souls (Otto Frank, his wife Edith and daughters Anne and Margot as well as four others) in hiding in the Secret Annex. And it was Miep who found Anne's Diary and kept it safe so Otto, the only one of the eight who survived, could later share it with the world as one of the most powerful accounts of the Holocaust.

name: A Gentleman in Moscow
summary: A Gentleman in Moscow tells the story of Count Rostov, who took the wrong side of history in Moscow in 1922. The Communist Party agrees to save him, but he is not allowed to leave the Metropole Hotel until his death.

1923 focuses on the Dutton family's next two generations as they struggle to survive historic drought, lawlessness and prohibition, and an epidemic of cattle theft; all battled beneath the cloud of Montana's great depression, which preceded the nation by almost a decade.

name: A Friend of the Family
summary: A Friend of the Family is based on the harrowing true story of the Broberg family, whose daughter Jan was kidnapped multiple times over a period of years by a charismatic, obsessed family "friend". The Brobergs — devoted to their faith, family, and community — were utterly unprepared for the sophisticated tactics their neighbor used to exploit their vulnerabilities, drive them apart, and turn their daughter against them. This is the story of how their lives were permanently altered — and how they survived.

name: The Real Death in Paradise
summary: Brits love to escape the miserable weather for sunny skies and sandy beaches. But what happens when a trip to paradise turns into a bloody nightmare? Explore the details behind solved and unsolved cases of murders in paradise.

previousepisode.name: India: The Body In The Tree

name: The X-Family
summary: Beside our own space and time, there are eleven other dimensions exist side by side with Mojie, a dimension where evil resides. And this story began in the Gold dimension where Da Dong and his gang lived and fought the dark forces from Mojie. After the gang lost all their powers in the last battle, Xiu travelled to other dimensions to find Da Dong's alternate self. His search led him to a boy named Xia Tian in the Iron dimension. The boy's incredible power is sealed away by a Fenglongtie on his neck. If he could harness the boy's power, the boy can save all the worlds from falling into the hands of Mojie.

name: Stress Things ATEEZ
summary: ATEEZ members are welcomed to a strange mansion. Where tons of mysterious creatures reside. Once they step in, they can't leave the mansion. The only way to get out is by collecting survival points.

name: Conquering Southern China
summary: Two seasoned Youtube vloggers bike 5000km through the weirdest and wildest back roads of southern China. Join Winston Sterzel, "The Original China Vlogger," and his fellow Youtuber, C-Milk, on their epic southern China adventure. They tackle tough roads, witness breath-taking scenery, sample weird food and meet fascinating locals along the way. This is China like you've never seen it before.

name: Conquering Northern China
summary: Popular Youtube vloggers, SerpentZA & Laowhy86, head to the northernmost point of China on their most grueling and punishing adventure to date.

name: Soundtrack #1
summary: Two people have been friends for two decades, but just two weeks of living together erase the fine line between love and friendship. Han Sung Woo is a handsome novice photographer with a kind and caring character, and Seo Eun Soo is a lively, straightforward and honest girl who openly expresses her feelings. Three years ago, she took the chance to become a lyricist. Now the details of their related romance are subtly woven into her musical compositions.

name: Hillsong: A Megachurch Exposed
summary: With more than 150,000 global members, Hillsong has recently been entangled in scandal. Hillsong: A Megachurch Exposed will profile numerous ex-members of the church who have come forward to share harrowing allegations of the trauma, abuse, financial and labor exploitation that created a culture of chaos within the church. The series will also examine how Hillsong was able to grow into a global brand, while uncovering the truth behind the headlines of recent scandals and shining a light on the fine line between culture, corporation and cult.

name: Tayat Pan Kao Nieow
summary: Follows the story on the inheritance of a family business.  When the business owner's will leaves the assets to a mistress, controversy arises.

name: Bilardo: El doctor del fútbol
summary: Bilardo: El doctor del fútbol looks at the life of celebrated coach and doctor, Carlos Salvador Bilardo, who mentored the Argentine players to win the World Cup in Mexico 1986. Through this documentary, the viewers will get a glimpse into the real-life of Bilardo, his library, his passions for football, the sacrifices made by him, his obsessions, and a lot more.

name: Hackad
summary: You are never alone. Your movements are constantly monitored, as are your choices and opinions. Everything is registered and monitored. How easy is it to take over your digital life? And how easy would it be for an attacker to take over companies and authorities in Sweden? The series Hackad is an experiment where hackers tricks their way into companies and take over their networks. We get to see how easy it is to follow every trace that a private person leaves behind and how easy it can be to make payments in someone else's name.

name: The Comment Section
summary: It's going DOWN in the comments in this new weekly show from defender of women on the internet, Drew Afualo! Join Drew and a new weekly guest as they explore the dreaded comment section of their tagged videos on TikTok. Through a candid discussion and lots of laughs, Drew keeps it real and gives in-depth advice on the issues that you care about most.

previousepisode.name: Men Love to Go Off Topic

name: Shortland Street: Retribution
summary: Dark, gritty and unrelenting – this is Shorty as you've never seen it. Esther surprises Curtis in Christchurch and is shocked to discover he is firmly entrenched in the criminal underworld. Suitable for mature audiences and viewer discretion is advised.

name: Horrible Histories Top 5
summary: Celebrity guests present a top 5 countdown of classic Horrible History clips.

previousepisode.name: Black History Month with Oti Mabuse

name: Friday Night Feast
summary: I'm Patrick Christys. It's Friday night! Let's kick-start the weekend. If you want boring, change channels. Let's have a few laughs and a unique take on the hottest news topics. Expect the unexpected.

name: Alex Agnew's Fear Factor
summary: Alex Agnew brings back the groundbreaking Fear Factor in his own crazy way. 16 unknown duos look their worst fears straight in the eye. In Alex Agnew's Fear Factor no one is spared and it is, sometimes literally, sink or swim. Only the duo that manages to keep a cool head is crowned the winner.

name: The Big Conn
summary: The Big Conn tells the unbelievable true story of the larger-than-life attorney, Eric C. Conn, who defrauded the government over half a billion dollars in the largest Social Security fraud case in history.

name: Lizzo's Watch Out for the Big Grrrls
summary: Multi-platinum Music Icon Lizzo is in search of her next BIG GRRRL dancers as she heads into her 2022 tour. 13 hopefuls arrive in Hollywood, CA, to leave it all on the floor for a chance to be chosen to take center stage at the Bonnaroo music festival. The stakes are high for the hopefuls and Icon herself as this will be her first time performing in front of a stadium crowd in two years.

name: Folkevalgt
summary: A new generation is fighting for a seat in the Storting. Do they have what it takes to govern the country?

name: Reunited
summary: Alex Gilbert grew up in New Zealand after being adopted from a Russian orphanage when he was two. He searched and reunited with his birth family, sparking a quest to help fellow adoptees do the same.

name: Loggerheads
summary: Two teams of woodworkers have 24 hours to transform freshly felled trees into something spectacular, battling each other and the elements - but who will claim the Golden Axe?

name: Great Expectations
summary: Great Expectations is the coming-of-age story of Pip, an orphan who yearns for a greater lot in life until a twist of fate introduces him to the mysterious and eccentric Miss Havisham and Estella, showing him a dark world of possibilities. Under the great expectations placed upon him, Pip will have to work out the cost of this new world and whether it will truly make him the man he wishes to be.

name: Saretagawa no Blue
summary: Noburu is a handsome designer who draws a high salary and has a good marriage with Aiko, whom he much loves. That is until Noburu witnesses Aiko enjoying an affair with her boss and looking very happy. Feeling betrayed, Noboru decides to get revenge on his wife.

name: Coffee Ikaga Deshou
summary: Hajime Aoyama runs the mobile coffee shop Tako Coffee. Riding in his coffee truck, he goes from street to street. Along the way, he comforts those with wounded hearts and minds. Hajime Aoyama appears carefree, but he has a secret.

name: Into the Wild Frontier
summary: Early pioneers, scouts, hunters, and traders fulfill America's destiny to expand Westward, exploring uncharted territory to blaze new trails. While dangers of deadly predators, starvation, bad weather, and unwelcoming Native Americans linger around every corner, the promise of land and opportunity push brave men like Daniel Boone, Kit Carson, and John Colter to keep going. Within the epic adventures and survival of the early settlers lies the origins of Western lore and the creation of legends that live on forever.

previousepisode.name: John Mullan: Roadbuilder of the West

name: Nusumareta Kao: Miatari Sosahan
summary: Shirato Takamasa is a detective at the Investigation Cooperation Section of the Tokyo Metropolitan Police Department. His job is to catch wanted criminals by only relying on their faces. One day, he sees Sunami's face who was a senior detective, but had a mysterious death 4 years ago.

name: THE LETTERs
summary: A short history about love found in letters.

name: The Julia Child Challenge
summary:
The competitors, all Julia Child superfans, share personal stories about their hero, cook in a kitchen recreated in the likeness of where Julia herself cooked, using the same ingredients Julia used and are even guided by Julia herself, through a larger-than-life television screen right in the middle of all the action. Head judgeAntonia Lofaso and a rotating panel of guest judges including Molly Baz, Cliff Crooks and Brooke Williamsonultimately decide who wins the life-changing grand prize that literally follows in Julia's footsteps: an all-expense paid three-month cooking course at Le Cordon Bleu.

Working in conjunction with The Julia Child Foundation for Gastronomy and the Culinary Arts to ensure this series reflects Julia's incredible talent and heart, each episode features two rounds of competitive cooking: the first-round masters the basics and challenges the competitors to recreate one of Julia's signature dishes, with some guidance from Julia herself, as seen on a giant television screen in the middle of the action.  Round two is an ode to Julia, where competitors must take inspiration from Julia to create a unique dish reflecting their own culinary point of view. Round two dishes are served family-style, with competitors and judges sampling each dish and sharing stories about their food and personal connection to Julia. Based on performance, the judges name one winner and send one competitor home each week, until the last cook standing is awarded the ultimate grand prize.

previousepisode.name: Mastering the Art of Julia Child

name: Mushoboke
summary: Depicts the life of a former yakuza who was released for the first time in 14 years.

name: YO! MTV RAPS
summary: From MTV Entertainment Studios, the reimagined global iteration will include hosted segments, live performances, cyphers, and lifestyle content, and serve as a comprehensive deep dive into the current state of hip hop.

name: Roman to the Rescue
summary: Young animal rescuer Roman McConn finds homes for memorable shelter dogs with real kids across the country.

name: Rock Till We Drop
summary: Martin Kemp, bassist from Spandau Ballet and grime artist Lady Leshurr meet to discuss the terms of the competition. "No kids!" they agree but now the hard work begins to find incredible musicians over the age of 64 with no upper age limit to form two rock ‘n' roll bands.

name: Fear Factor
summary: Fear Factor is the groundbreaking show presented by Walter Grootaers, in which contestants have to overcome their fears and successfully complete spectacular stunts.

name: Remember 15
summary:
"I miss you all.. Shall we reunite at the island?, a message from Lyla, a school queen who committed suicide 5 years ago, was sent to her friends, seniors, and sisters mysteriously. Despite the conundrum, everyone has somehow decided to return to that island again after reading the message. To their surprise as they reach on the island, the truce of darkness of the past reality unfolds. The beautiful dream island which everyone has ever dreamed of has turned out to be a bloodshed fight between those who called themselves as "friends". 

If you don't remember, I will remind you.

name: Yorkshire Ripper: The Secret Murders
summary: Series examining the police investigation into the crimes of serial killer Peter Sutcliffe, known as the Yorkshire Ripper, and the missed opportunities to charge him for his earlier, unacknowledged crimes.

name: Ruby and the Well
summary: Teenager Ruby O'Reilly and her father Daniel are ready for a fresh start when they inherit an orchard in the town of Emerald. When Ruby discovers an old wishing well on their land, she becomes the newest well keeper. Now, it's up to Ruby to grant the unfulfilled wishes of the townspeople. Using empathy, kindness, and a lot of grit, Ruby and her best friends Sam and Mina work to make every wish come true in Emerald.

name: Pardon the Expression
summary: Leonard Swindley (played by Arthur Lowe) was the central character. Formerly the manager of the fashion retail store "Gamma Garments" in Coronation Street, in this series he is the deputy manager of the department store Dobson and Hawks. His boss in the series was Ernest Parbold played by Paul Dawkins who was replaced by Wally Hunt played by Robert Dorning in series 2. Other regulars were Betty Driver as canteen lady, Mrs Edgeley and Joy Stewart as Miss Sinclair, the boss's secretary.

name: Todesspiel
summary: The dramatic weeks of the "German Autumn 1977", the RAF kidnapping of employer president Hanns Martin Schleyer and the hijacking of the Lufthansa plane "Landshut" by a Palestinian terrorist commando kept the republic in suspense almost 30 years ago. With archive footage, eyewitness interviews and staged game scenes, the two-part film "Todesspiel" by Heinrich Breloer recalls the events of those 45 days and was euphorically celebrated after it was first broadcast almost 10 years ago.

name: Kid of the Year
summary: Celebrating everyday kids who make an enormous impact!

name: BearShark
summary: Two of nature's bloodthirstiest predators, one solitary mission: eat this dude.

name: The Adventures of Kim Jong Un
summary: A leaked North Korean cartoon presenting the totally true triumphs of the totally not pudgy Great Leader.

previousepisode.name: Kim Jong Un vs. Kim Jong Il: Part 2

name: Pisarze. Serial na krótko
summary: The director Mikołaj Lizut invited the biggest contemporary writers in Poland to compose very short stories and gave them absolute artistic freedom. Their only limitation was time: stories could not be longer than 5 minutes. He cast two of the most famous Polish actors over age 40 and sketched the writers' ideas in a rather distanced and very witty manner.

name: Uprooted
summary: Three-Episode Docuseries Launching Friday, February 18, on discovery+ Reveals New Information in the Decades-Old Unsolved Death of Keith Warren. Never thoroughly investigated, Keith Warren's sister Sherri has spent 35 years seeking the truth about what happened to her brother. Fighting systemic corruption at every turn, her end goal is to change Keith's death certificate to reflect the truth. Featuring interviews with Keith Warren's friends and family as well as both active and retired law enforcement, forensic experts, eyewitnesses and private investigators, Uprooted includes never-before-reported support for the probability Keith Warren did not die by suicide.

name: Going to You at a Speed of 493 km
summary: A sports romance drama that depicts the passion and affection for badminton of a male and female protagonist who is a mixed doubles group with players from the badminton business team. Park Tae Joon, who naturally wound up in the world of badminton because of his parents' badminton equipment business. Although he had begun to see the sport as work, his passion for badminton is reignited due to a desire to impress a woman. Park Tae Yang is a former aspiring Olympian who had to leave the badminton world for three years due to a bribing scandal.

name: Theodore Roosevelt
summary: Two-part series on U.S. President Theodore Roosevelt looking at his work as a progressive reformer as well as his contradictions such as being a passionate conservationist who also hunted animals.

name: Catching a Killer: The Hwaseong Murders
summary:
South Korea's most infamous murder case involving one of the country's first known serial killers. The notorious killer plagued the rural city of Hwaseong with 10 murders in just four years, leading to the largest manhunt the country has ever seen.

Catching a Killer recaps the twists and turns of the police investigation, the vital evidence that was overlooked and the emotional trauma felt in a town where locals were scared to leave their homes.

name: Wolf Pack
summary: Based on the book series by Edo van Belkom, Wolf Pack follows a teenage boy and girl whose lives are changed forever when a California wildfire awakens a terrifying supernatural creature and drives it to attack a highway traffic jam beneath the burning hills. Wounded in the chaos, the boy and girl are inexplicably drawn to each other and to two other teenagers who were adopted sixteen years earlier by a park ranger after another mysterious wildfire. As the full moon rises, all four teens come together to unravel the secret that connects them - the bite and blood of a werewolf.

name: Rebecca
summary: Six years after giving up the hunt for a serial killer and leaving the police, Rebecca decides to return to service to escape the depression that is eating away at her and keeping her away from her husband and children. Back in the Criminal Department, she investigates a series of murders and is convinced that the killer is the one she had not been able to stop six years ago. She pursues him relentlessly but memory loss disrupts her work. And when one of the victims turns out to be her husband's mistress, she finds herself directly involved: why was she the only one to know where the body of this woman was? Was it the serial killer who killed her...or was it her, during one of these blackouts? How to investigate when you think yourself guilty? Rebecca will have to reconstruct her past piece by piece to discover the terrifying event that triggered her neurosis and may have led her to kill.

name: A Rainha e a Bastarda
summary: A period series that tells the story of a mystery in the reign of D. Dinis and Queen Santa Isabel and the life of the kingdom of Portugal in the 14th century.

name: Æon Flux
summary: Credited for laying the groundwork as one of the first anime female superheroes, Æon Flux returns as a reimagined live-action series. Set in a post-apocalyptic near future where countries no longer exist, reduced to Spartan like city-states locked in perpetual war, where children are turned into lethal soldiers and every citizen carries a gun, one young woman rises up to rebel against her Orwellian government as she becomes the hero known as Æon Flux.

name: The Crack of Dawn
summary: The drama tells a story of self-preservation and strength of an ordinary woman who worked hard for a life of stability who is faced with her husband's malice and betrayal, the burdens and problems of life.

name: Donde hubo fuego
summary: When clues to his brother's murder lead Poncho to a fire brigade, he joins it to investigate further and finds romance, family... and a serial killer.

name: Николай Вавилов
summary: Biopic devoted to the history of the life of Soviet biologist, academician Nikolai Vavilov. His scientific and personal confrontation with Trofim Lysenko, the subsequent arrest and death of the scientist in prison.

name: Heroes of Lucha Libre
summary: Heroes of Lucha Libre is a superhero show based on the centenary tradition of Lucha Libre. Fights, drama, heroes and superpowers combined in a show that offers the highest production and VFX standards in a powerful and entertained TV series. The four islands embark with Luchador Wars to win the Four Power Rings of Earth, Wind, Fire, and Water, so they can claim the Sacred Belt of Xarunca, which will make them Masters of the Universe.

name: Real Steel
summary: TV series based on the 2011 film, which followed an ex-boxer and father, played by Hugh Jackman, and son, played by Dakota Goyo, as they reconcile years of distance and discover an obsolete junkyard sparring robot who just might be more than it seems.

name: Salade Grecque
summary: Salade Grecque is a contemporary sequel to the movie trilogy L'Auberge Espagnole (The Spanish Apartment or Pot Luck), 20 years after the originals. It follows the lives of Tom and Mia (the children of Xavier and Wendy from L'Auberge Espagnole) as they embark on a new adventure in Athens, Greece. The series follows the journey of two protagonists who are 19 and 25, roughly the same age as Xavier, Romain Duris's character in the trilogy, as they deal with everyday life, the financial crisis, sexual identity issues, as well as the situation facing migrants in Greece.

name: Deadloch
summary: The Tasmanian town of Deadloch, a once sleepy seaside hamlet, is left reeling when a local man turns up dead on the beach. Two female detectives are thrown together to solve the case, fastidious local Senior Sergeant Dulcie Collins and a rough as guts blow in from Darwin, Senior Investigator Eddie Redcliffe along with their overeager junior constable Abby. As the town prepares to launch the annual arts, food and culture Winter "Feastival", the trio has to put their differences aside and work together to find the killer.

name: Aller simple
summary: Six people who do not know each other are invited under various pretexts to stay at the prestigious estate of a billionaire. The helicopter that is to transport them is forced into an emergency landing. As the group settles down to wait for help, mysterious accidents and disappearances follow one another. What could a former policeman, a religious art dealer, a retired teacher, a marketing director, a star criminal lawyer and a businesswoman have in common to find themselves trapped in this way?

name: L'Homme que j'ai condamné
summary: Appointed to be a juror in a criminal trial, Inès, a 40-year-old nurse, helps to convict the accused, a man with a violent past. At the end of the trial, she is seized with a terrible doubt: what if she had just sent an innocent man behind bars? If she had just unjustly separated a father from his 8-year-old son, whom he will not see grow up? With the help of a private detective with a strong character, Inès will start her own counter-investigation, which will take her much further than she thinks...

name: Frank Riva
summary: After 25 years in exile, undercover cop Frank Riva comes back in Paris. He faces mob boss Norbert Loggia and his son Maxime, who put a bounty on his head during the French Connection days.

name: Johnny par Johnny
summary: Johnny Hallyday tells his story in his own words. Through archival footage and personal testimonials, Johnny by Johnny is an intimate portrait of the life and career of France's greatest rock icon.

name: Devoured
summary: A series set at the intersection of true crime & food, tracking true stories that have altered the culinary landscape.

name: Youth Should be Early
summary: At the graduation ceremony, Cheng Xin proposes to his boyfriend Zheng Gong, but he unexpectedly rejects the offer. While Cheng Xin continues to work in his family's corporation, Zheng Gan has difficulty finding a job. Cheng Xin secretly helps him get an interview without his knowledge. But when the truth comes out, not only does he lose his job and reputation in this field, but the relationship between him and Cheng Xin is destroyed. Will Zheng Gan be able to get back on his feet and believe in love again?

name: Moors Murders
summary: The dark story of Britain's most infamous child murders, retold with eyewitness accounts and new analysis of never-before-seen prison letters from killers Ian Brady and Myra Hindley.

name: The King of Pigs
summary: Two men became victims of school violence 20 years ago. One of them becomes a serial killer to punish evil and the other one a detective on a case trying to catch him.

name: Hotel Margaret
summary: Hungary's favorite influencers arrive at a prestigious awards ceremony in Tihany to find out who has become the most successful videographer of the year. During the award ceremony, after the shooting of a faulty confetti cannon, the winner collapses on stage. Was there an accident or an intentional murder?

name: Технарь
summary: Igor Odintsov is a unique specialist in security systems. But even the most sophisticated technology can fail. An unknown person easily penetrates into his "smart house", stuffed with miracle gadgets up to the roof, and takes Igor's wife and son hostage. Now, in order to save his loved ones, Odintsovo needs to commit a crime himself: apply his skills to please the bandits. However, a slippery path rarely leads to a happy ending, and now the hero is rushing through Moscow at night with a heap of new problems, without a clue how to fix his seemingly perfect life.

name: De Avondshow met Arjen Lubach
summary: Arjen Lubach dives through the issues of the day past inspiring guests to the bottom of the news. Everyone always wants to go from the issues of the day to deepening. Arjen is really looking forward to the issues of the day.

name: Zachowaj spokój
summary: Zachowaj spokój is another Netflix title based on the novel by Harlan Coben. The six-episode series is set in a wealthy housing estate, where the local community leads a quiet life with close relationships. Everything changes when 18-year-old Adam disappears without a trace. The danger escalates quickly, and the worried parents do everything they can to protect their children who, on the verge of adulthood, have decided to take matters into their own hands. Hold Tight is a dynamic, twist-filled thriller that, while not a sequel to The Woods, will feature the fate of several protagonists of Harlan Coben's first screen adaptation.

name: Queer·ious
summary: Queer·ious portrays the lives of a lesbian group of friends as they explore love, dating, secrets and betrayal while living in Los Angeles.

name: Après
summary: Après recounts the aftermath of a tragic event that suddenly arose in Lac Sabin, a small town in the Laurentians. The story begins in the seconds following the disastrous event and depicts the physical, psychological and social consequences of this tragedy that no one could have foreseen or avoided. Nothing will now be the same in the quiet municipality. It is fear, mourning, incomprehension. There are the victims, the survivors and all those around them who try to understand the irreparable.

name: Unpaused: Naya Safar
summary: Unpaused: Naya Safar continues to takes the legacy of the first anthology forward and yet again brings together 5 unique filmmakers - Nupur Asthana, Ayappa KM, Ruchir Arun, Shikha Makan and Nagraj Manjule - with new stories of hope, love, connections and second chances that celebrate the resilient human spirit in these uncertain times.

name: Dangerous
summary: Revolves around the life of Aditya Dhanraj, a young struggling entrepreneur, who discovers that his wife Diya Dhanraj has gone missing. He sets out to find his wife with the help of the police, only to discover that his ex-girlfriend Neha Singh will be handling his case. In pursuit of the truth, will they dig into many 'dangerous' hidden secrets like murder, kidnapping or even a case of business rivalry? Or is there something more to the case than meets the eye?

name: The Great Indian Murder
summary: When notorious industrialist Vicky Rai gets killed at a party, the main suspects are the guests - both invited and uninvited.

name: Meeno's Yorizori
summary: A show where the Minoi performer receives guests and cooks.

previousepisode.name: EP.17 Ra Mi Ran & Kim Mu Yeol
Miracle Card Battler- Bashin Breaks Through From the Front!

name: Te Voy a Enseñar a Querer
summary: Diana Rivera is a beautiful and brave young veterinarian. In a nightclub, he meets Pablo Méndez and rejects him for his arrogant rich-boy style. Pablo falls in love with her and decides to win her over. A few days later, Diana is hired to work at the Méndez ranch and meets Alejandro Méndez, Pablo's father. Alejandro Méndez is a successful rancher. Happily married to his wife Isabel and father of Pablo and Helena. He dedicates his time to what he is most passionate about, his ranch of fighting bulls and rejoneo horses, which together with his real estate business, allow him to enjoy a high standard of living reserved for few. His life changes drastically when his wife Isabel dies unexpectedly and he falls into a deep depression. Diana convinces him to fight again for the only thing that can bring him back to life. Together they will face adversity and fall in love with each other, but they do not dare to speak of love, for fear of not being reciprocated.

name: My Beloved (?) In-law
summary: Chom is a hi-so girl who just returned from studying abroad and is being forced by her mother to marry someone of her mother's choosing. Chom doesn't want to and wants to be able to choose for herself who she will marry. She meets a country bumpkin named Nin and they enter into a fake marriage to prevent Chom's mother from making her marry someone else. Will this fake marriage between a hi-so girl and a country bumpkin turn into real love? And will Chom's mother finally accept Nin for her daughter?

name: Wasteland
summary: The world's wealthiest nation hides a problem you've never thought about, but can no longer ignore. Too much waste, and an inadequate way to clean it up. Failing septic tanks and collapsing sewer lines are shooting raw waste into people's homes. Untreated sewage is poisoning rivers and polluting coastlines. Wasteland examines how we got here, and whether overproduction of waste, and a crumbling infrastructure can keep up, before the problem blows up in our faces.

name: Dale Gas
summary: After a race they drive in ends fatally, friends Kike and Noche flee to Mexico City to hide, rebuild their lives and escape danger ... or at least try.

name: The Pact
summary: The story follows a family strained past the breaking point by a post-apocalyptic world as they travel alongside other survivors seeking the cause and cure for the Miasma, a mysterious fog that drives victims insane.

name: Vostro Onore
summary:
Vittorio Pagani is a judge in Milan renown for his righteousness and on the verge of becoming the president of Milan Tribunal. On the sentimental front, however, he is deeply shaken by the recent death of his wife that has complicated the already difficult relationship with his son Matteo. Their lifes will be further upset when the boy runs over the young member of a crime family, the Silvas, with his car.

Following this tragic event, Vittorio will understand that he is ready to do anything to protect his son's life, even at the cost of questioning the integrity of his career and the righteousness of his life. Furthermore, this mafia family is already an old acquaintance of the judge: in the past, it was him who, as Public Prosecutor, dismantled this organization and get the clan chief arrested.

Therefore, Vittorio will have to do everything to protect himself and his son: if it were found out who caused the accident, the mafia group would not hesitate for a moment to kill Matteo, in order to obtain the much desired revenge.

name: Sherri
summary: Sherri is a talk show hosted by Sherri Shepherd that will cover the popular "Hot Topics" segment, with actor-comedian, author and TV personality Shepherd putting her own spin on it.

name: Superfan
summary: Superfan is a musical spectacle disguised as a game show that will feature several rounds of play where fans will have the ability to advance to a final round for the chance to prove they are the ultimate fan. Each episode will name one superfan who will win the ultimate experience with the featured artist.

name: Futha Mucka
summary: Samuel L. Jackson and Ryan Reynolds love each other. More accurately, Ryan loves Sam. When a minor mishap causes Sam to become Ryan's primary caregiver, things get weird.

name: Supernormal
summary: A comedy about what it means to be the top executive at an investment bank at the same as being a mother in the 21st century.

name: The History of the Red Army
summary: For 70 years, the Red Army was one of the foundations of the USSR, an instrument of fear as well as admiration, a symbol of liberation as well as coercion.

name: We Are Black and British
summary: Six black Britons from different backgrounds come together. Each shares a deeply personal story, raising tough questions about being black and British in search of answers.

name: Unspun World with John Simpson
summary: Unspun World provides an unvarnished version of the week's major global news stories - reliable, honest and essential viewing with the BBC's world affairs editor John Simpson.

name: Today at the Caravan Show
summary: Highlights from the Caravan, Camping & Motorhome Show, home to lovers of the outdoors.

name: Is It Cake?
summary: Deception is the name of the game for the world's most talented bakers who will compete to create hyper-realistic cakes that look exactly like everyday objects – with cash on the line. But are they good enough to deceive a panel of celebrity judges… and you? You'll be asking yourself ‘is it real?' Or…Is It Cake?"

name: Meu Amigãozão
summary: Meu Amigãozão (My Big Big Friend) is a Brazilian series created by Claudia Koogan Breitman and Andrés Lieban, shown on the Discovery Kids channel and licensed by the Agência Nacional do Cinema (ANCINE). Each character has their "Big Buddy". Yuri is the main character of the series, and is five years old. Yuri is intelligent, independent and happy, as well as having a very fertile imagination. Yuri discovers he's very brave when Goliath, his big friend, arrives.

previousepisode.name: You Can't Make Me / Toy Drive

name: Lov3
summary: Siblings Sofia, Beto and Ana refuse to experience love and sex like their parents. And that feeling grows stronger when their mother decides to end a 30-year-long marriage. The separation is the event that makes the three of them reevaluate their own emotional choices — and their ability to take care of each other while, at the same time, trying not to stifle their own identities.

name: Villa Oranje
summary: With the European Championship just around the corner, Wesley Sneijder, Dirk Kuyt, Mark van Bommel and John Heitinga look back, but also ahead to the upcoming European Championship.

name: Byron Baes
summary: Australian influencers flock to Byron Bay for its warm, beachy beauty and cool, creative vibe. Follow these friends as they negotiate life and love.

name: Last One Standing
summary: They're comedians starring in a thrilling drama, but if their jokes don't land in the unscripted scenes, they're off the show. Let the mayhem begin!

name: The Andy Warhol Diaries
summary: After he's shot in 1968, Andy Warhol begins documenting his life and feelings. Those diaries, and this series, reveal the secrets behind his persona.

name: Phoenix Rising
summary: Phoenix Rising delves behind familiar headlines and explores the often-misunderstood aspects of domestic abuse, helping to shed light on the many factors that prevent survivors from coming forward with their stories as they deal with years of aftershocks and emotional trauma.

name: Мой ангел
summary: Arkady is about thirty, and he himself knows that he is a weakling. He was kicked out of work, he lost his home and his beloved girlfriend... It was at this moment that Angela appeared in his life. She seems so carefree, so reckless. Next to her, Arkady can somehow handle everything. There is more between them than falling in love. In a matter of days they become true friends. But it soon becomes clear that angels are not such easy creatures, and their lives can be very difficult...

name: Не приходи ко мне во сне
summary: Lesya and Veronica are sisters on their father's side, and more recently, best friends. Lesya dreams of singing on stage, Veronica helps her sister make her dream come true. But the fashion producer chooses not Lesya, but the liberated Veronica... Suddenly, misfortunes begin to haunt Veronica - people close to her die under mysterious circumstances. The girl herself gets into an accident and miraculously survives. Lesya discovers that she dreamed of all these misfortunes before and then became reality... Is she subconsciously jealous of her sister and going crazy? Or does she have a split personality and is a killer?

name: Огнеборцы
summary:
Another visit by employees of the regular Moscow district fire department ends tragically. While rescuing a homeless person from a fire, fire crew commander Zakhar Kuznetsov dies.
The man rescued from the burnt-out homeless site turns out to be a sailor of the trawl fleet, Denis Ragozin, who came to the capital in search of his runaway wife. Having learned from Captain Mitrokhin, who is investigating the fire, the name of his savior, Denis decides to become a firefighter and go to work in the unit where the deceased Kuznetsov served.
However, not everyone likes Ragozin's wishes. Kuznetsov's wife, who got a job as a dispatcher at the fire department after her husband's death, the new crew commander Zubov and some other ordinary firefighters do not want to see Ragozin. But perseverance and dedication help Denis achieve his goal and become one of the best among the capital's firefighters...

name: Танкер «Танго»
summary: Purposeful and serious entrepreneur Andrei Grekov found himself in a very unpleasant situation and was forced to pay a large sum of money. However, now is not the best time in the hero's life, his property has been confiscated, and he doesn't have a penny in his pocket. The only valuables the young man has left are an old tanker, thanks to which he receives a strange order for the transportation of oil. The hero doesn't think long about the suspicious matter, because the money needs to be given back very urgently. A seemingly simple task turned out to be not so easy, and now Andrei found himself in the midst of dangerous and serious events.

name: Беременна в 45
summary: Our whole life is a battle against stereotypes. When are you getting married? When you become a mum? When to have a second? 45 years old - is it too late? Overcoming, disappointment, tears, laughter, joy and happiness - the whole spectrum of human emotions will be seen by the viewers of the channel "Yu" in a new reality show about women who decided to become mothers after 45.

name: Royal Feast
summary: Set during the Ming dynasty during the rule of Yongle Emperor, it tells the story of a young girl named Yao Zijin, who entered the palace to become a maid of the food bureau. In the deep palace, she remains determined and slowly work her way up while perfecting her craft; while friendship and romance at the same time. Through her romantic entanglement with Zhu Zhanji, the drama also showcases the historical achievements and family life of three outstanding emperors of the Ming Dynasty, portraying a gourmet Forbidden City full of rich family affection, friendship, love and humanity.

name: Vandaag Inside
summary: Talkshow with Wilfred, Johan and Rene about the news of today.

name: Власть
summary: To save a beloved girl who needs expensive treatment, the artist kidnaps nine young female fans of a popular music group. He gets in touch with their relatives and demands a ransom. However, when the money is collected, the kidnapper disappears without a trace. This is how a dangerous game begins, where power passes from the hands of the executioners into the hands of their victims.

name: Transformers: BotBots
summary: When the lights go out at the mall, the BotBots come out to play! Meet a fun-loving crew of everyday objects that morph into robots at closing time.

previousepisode.name: The Goldrush Games - Part the Second

name: Silverpoint
summary: Four kids at Silverpoint Adventure Camp stumble upon something strange buried out in the woods, which sends their lives and the world around them spiralling out of control.

previousepisode.name: How I Wonder What You Are

name: Krøll
summary: Auriane used strong chemicals to change herself. Today she has a dream of going with great afro, but why is this so difficult and scary?

name: Алиса не может ждать
summary: "Alyssa" is a story about the fragility of growing up, the fear of loneliness and the importance of motherly love and support. Alyssa is only fifteen, and her teachers are tired of calling her mother into school, while Alyssa's mother can't understand what is going on with her child. Alyssa then finally learns what has been hidden from her for years: she will soon go completely blind. A little longer, and she will be in total darkness. She vows to live to the fullest while she can and decides that it would be stupid to waste time on school. It is better to grow up fast, earn some easy money, and move to a big and beautiful city. But pretty soon Alyssa's teenage illusions are shattered by reality, and her mother's strategy of pretending that all is well will inevitably lead to disaster.

name: Irodorimidori
summary: At Maigahara Music College Affiliate School Maigahara Senior High (abbreviated as MaiMai) that gathers the most promising musical talents, there's a rumor circulating among students. "If you give an amazing performance at the school festival, you get special extra credit (or so they say)." Serina's grades are not very good, so she immediately believes the rumor and decides to form a band.

name: L'Oeil Du Cyclone
summary: A cyclone is a meteorological phenomenon that occurs when you have to manage 3 children, a self-employed job, an ex-boyfriend and his new too-young girlfriend, daycare schedules, meals, school, lunches, the new employee - And in the eye of this Cyclone is Isabelle, 39 years old, a single mother who has the mental burden of all this in addition to having to put up with a sister who is better than she is at everything, a mother who reminds her that her sister is better than she is at everything, and a barren love life.

name: My Liberation Diary
summary: It tells the story of three siblings who want to escape their stifling lives and a mysterious outsider who comes to their town.

name: Ларинские блудни
summary: The show tells about cult personalities studying at the Murom Institute.

name: Два Холма
summary:
What will happen if, as a result of biological warfare, almost the entire male population dies out? Women will get excited (not for long), and then they will unite and create a new better world — with eco-towns, renewable energy, opportunities to do whatever they want, even science and biohacking, even yoga and self-development. Reproduction now takes place by artificial insemination, and only girls are born in the new world.

But not everyone likes such a world order. Some of the surviving men and women loyal to them go to live in abandoned megacities, start stealing electricity, enjoying freedom and traditional sex. The tranquility of the perfectly arranged female world is under threat when the teacher Rada from the eco-city "Two Hills" meets a young "primate" Hera outside of it.

previousepisode.name: Virna Lisi, Bobby Sherman, Skiles & Henderson

name: L'Île aux 30 cercueils
summary: The story takes place in 1917. Véronique is a young woman of 35 years, nurse at the military hospital of Besançon. She suddenly learns of the murder of her husband, the mysterious Count Vorski, whom she has not seen for fourteen years. Her research will also lead her to the track of her father and son whom she believed to have died in a shipwreck, already a long time ago. From clue to clue, here we are in Brittany, on this island with a name so ill-fitting... Brutal deaths, enigmatic words written... by whom? A frightening prophecy, the superstitious terror of the island's inhabitants, and suddenly, Veronica d'Hergemont can no longer leave this island. She's stuck alone. Almost alone...

name: Code Promo
summary: In the company of his fellow comedians, Stéphane Bern gives the "promotional artist" all the raw material to succeed in this exercise in other shows, with one objective: to be funny.

previousepisode.name: Chantal Ladesou, Marc Lavoine, Vincent Desagnat

name: Gossip: #Kanojo ga Shiritai Honto no ○○
summary:
Depicts the connection between people in a new era through the work, way of life, and romance of the people who work there, with the editorial staff of the news site as the main character.

Kanfuru News is an online news media website, run by a large publishing company. Their articles are written by the editorial team, who are all men, and consists mostly of rearranged stories and comments from other websites. Their goal is to only increase page views. One day, Seko Ririko is transferred to the editorial team from the accounting department.

name: Bee Czar
summary:
The series follows "Bee Czar" Walter Schumacher and his mission to save the planet through saving honeybees, all without wearing a protective suit — instead, he "communicates" with bees to avoid being stung. Schumacher works with his team at the American Honey Bee Protection Agency to rescue hives from places they're unwanted, like the walls of a house or up a neighborhood tree, and relocate them to sites where they can thrive in peace.

Bee Czar will show Schumacher's efforts to rebuild his business from the ground up after losing everything in the COVID-19 pandemic, transforming his family farm into a new headquarters for his work, and training rookie bee wranglers. The series will also feature his oldest son Will, who works to land contracts selling honey to businesses such as restaurants and distilleries.

name: Raised by Refugees
summary: Pax Assadi is your typical 12-year-old from the early 2000s. His parents came to NZ in the late '80s as refugees and want him to get good grades, but all Pax wants to do is fit in. However, a major international incident makes that very difficult.

name: Diary of a Very Angry Wife
summary: A journalist working in the same newspaper as her husband, and intellectual conflict arises between them because of the differences between the nature of men and women. The series shows the relationship between the spouses, revealing many attitudes of the "Eastern Man".

name: Valentino
summary: Nour Abdel Mejid, AKA Valentino, owns a number of international schools, "Valentino Schools", run by him and his domineering wife with whom he's not in agreement. Their disagreements, however, get them on several adventures and reveals many surprises along the way.

name: Big Restaurant Bet
summary:
Food Network star, acclaimed chef, and restaurateur Geoffrey Zakarian is looking to invest $250,000 of his resources for the next rising star in the restaurant world. Geoffrey presents eight talented chefs with the opportunity to take the next step in their culinary career with challenges to determine who has what it takes to run their first restaurant. When it comes to developing and operating a successful restaurant, there is no one with more knowledge than Geoffrey, and he is putting his reputation on the line to lift up a new generation of chefs competing to make their restaurant vision come true.

Throughout the competition the aspiring restaurateurs must prove they can develop a restaurant and make it profitable from the ground up in real world challenges that put their culinary and business expertise to the test, including the creation of a full menu for their proposed restaurant in a grand tasting to impress Geoffrey and his advisors. In another episode, the chefs tackle the challenges associated with running a restaurant's front of house as they each take turns helping the guests. But what the chefs don't know is Geoffrey has filled the restaurant with actors meant to cause havoc and see how the competitors react on their worst day. The two chefs who advance to the finale take on the hardest test of their life, operating their dream culinary concept in a restaurant takeover, complete with overseeing staffing and cooking for real diners. Which chef will Geoffrey decide to invest his time and energy into and make their dreams come true?

name: Our Blues
summary: An omnibus-style drama that tells the sweet, sour, and bitter life stories of diverse characters in the setting of Jeju Island.

name: Martin Kane, Private Eye
summary: Private detective Martin Kane works in New York solving crimes. Depending on the year, Kane was either smooth and suave or hard bitten and the cooperation he received from the police depended on the year. The only constant was Happy McMann's tobacco shop where Kane hung out.

name: Lockerbie: A Search for Truth
summary: Inspired by the true-life story, on December 21, 1988, 259 passengers and crew were killed when Pan Am Flight 103 exploded over Lockerbie 38 minutes after take-off, with a further 11 residents losing their life as the plane came down over the quiet, Scottish town. In the wake of the disaster and his daughter's death, Dr Jim Swire, is nominated spokesperson for the UK victims' families, who have united to demand truth and justice. Traveling across continents and political divides, Jim embarks on a relentless journey that not only jeopardizes his stability, family and life, but completely overturns his trust in the justice system. As the truth shifts under Jim's feet, his view of the world is left forever changed. Exploring events from the disaster and its aftermath, Lockerbie: A Search for Truth provides an intimate account of a man, a husband, and a father who risks everything in memory of his daughter and the unflinching pursuit of truth and justice.

name: Life on the Outside
summary: Would you let a convicted criminal stay in your home? Presented by Danielle Cormack, this ground-breaking new series follows a unique initiative to tackle recidivism - a person's relapse into criminal behavior. Follow four Australian households that are prepared to offer their spare room to a formerly incarcerated person for 100 days.

name: ZERV - Zeit der Abrechnung
summary: ZERV tells of the first years after the fall of the Wall, the breaks in life courses, of completely different biographies and of the successful encounter in the common fight against crime, which knows neither East nor West. ZERV stands for "Zentrale Ermittlungsstelle für Regierungs- und Vereinigungskriminalität", the Central Investigation Agency for Government and Association Crime, which was founded in Berlin in 1991 by decision of the federal government. Karo Schubert fought for a position as chief inspector in reunified Germany. When she investigates the murder of a high-ranking employee of the Ministry of Disarmament, she meets Peter Simon, the newly appointed Western Commissioner from the special unit ZERV for the first time. They are forced to investigate together - because both claim the murder case for their department. But the various tasks of the ZERV can only be solved for Peter Simon and his team in cooperation with the Eastern colleagues.

name: Matar al padre
summary: Matar al padre shows the story of Jacobo Vidal, an authoritarian lawyer in his work and in his family who wants to have control of all areas of his life and those around him, especially his children Valeria and Tomás. At the time of post-Olympic Barcelona, he will have no qualms about overcoming all obstacles that may arise so that the well-being of his family fits in with his vision of life. But fifteen years later, in the economic crisis, Jacobo will realize that his life is not as planned: his wife has thrown him out of the house, his son has given himself to alternative therapies, his daughter wants to live away from him and above it he is ruined and homeless. For all this, he begins to question his way of seeing life.

name: Force Book Show Real
summary: Force and Book, who've known each other for over fifteen years, take viewers on casual day trips within Thailand.

name: Bewitched by My Sexy Boyfriend
summary: Sakaino Hitomi is an honest lady from a well-to-do family. She is envied by everyone for being engaged with Akashi Keigo, a man with a good appearance, high income, high education, and kindness. Hitomi is about to get married but suddenly becomes attracted to a man, Manabu, who she met at a construction site.

name: Suits
summary: The Egyptian version of the famous American show Suits. Follow the story of Adam Mansour (Mike Ross) played by Ahmed Dawood and Zain Thabet (Harvey Specter) played by Asser Yassin.

name: Victor Sauvage
summary: After twenty years of traveling the world to take care of wild animals, Victor decided to get closer to his children aged 10 and 15. This is why he accepted the proposal of his childhood friend, Laurent, to take over the management of the Paraclete animal reserve. Victor still finds himself very sensitive to the charm of his wife, Mathilde, whom he has never stopped loving. For her part, if she had really turned the page, she would have asked for a divorce, right? Unless she has found comfort and tranquility with this "brave Henri", the good friend of always... Baptiste and Zoé rediscover a full-time father, and Victor must now assume shared custody of his children. A mission at least as demanding as his job as a veterinarian, and for which he is not quite prepared. Twenty years in the bush makes you forget the refueling at the supermarket and the traffic jams! But Victor chose this "reconversion" because he no longer wanted to live away from his children. Basically, he just changed jungle...

name: Reno 911! Defunded
summary: Budget cuts won't stop these incompetent deputy sheriffs from trying to uphold the law.

name: Chefi fara limite
summary: Brings in front of the viewers a cooking show with top ingredients: 3 famous chefs - chef Sorin Bontea, chef Florin Dumitrescu and chef Cătălin Scărlătescu, spectacular places, traditional recipes, carefully crafted missions, competition and suspense.

name: Ice Age: Scrat Tales
summary: Scrat, the hapless saber-toothed squirrel of the "Ice Age" adventures, who experiences the ups and downs of fatherhood, as he and the adorable, mischievous Baby Scrat, alternately bond with each other and battle for ownership of the highly treasured Acorn.

name: Összezárva Hajdú Péterrel
summary: Have you ever seen Péter Hajdú in his pajamas? Now it turns out what it's like when your friends and acquaintances jump up to him for a little casual togetherness. One day closed with Péter Hajdú. There is privacy in it!

name: Käthe und ich
summary: The psychologist Paul, who specializes in animal-assisted therapies, and the Australian Shepherd bitch Käthe take on demanding cases. The tandem helps people get back on their feet after accidents and illnesses.

name: The Range Rider
summary: The Range Rider was a youth friendly television western created by Gene Autry's company Flying A Productions in the early 1950s. The show starred professional stuntmen Jock Mahoney as the Range Rider and his sidekick Dick West played by young actor Dick Jones.

name: Brave Animated Series
summary: A group of superheroes sets out to rid the world of evil — only to realize they may not be standing on the side of justice. Based on a popular comic.

name: Death on the Beach
summary: Death on the Beach examines the tragic roll call of numerous young travellers who have died under mysterious circumstances on the popular, remote backpacking Thai island, Koh Tao.

name: Your Body Uncovered with Kate Garraway
summary: See your body like never before - from the inside out. Kate Garraway and Dr Guddi Singh use the latest technology to help patients understand their everyday medical conditions.

name: Սպանված աղավնի
summary: Eponymous adaptation of Armenian writer Nar-Dos's 1889 novella "The Killed Dove" about a tragic love story.

name: Viral
summary: The media reports on the rapid spread of a virus that transforms humans into wild beasts. Given this, Anna seeks to escape and get away from her family, but on the way, chaos takes over the situation and Anna will try to survive the infected who are dangerous in order to reunite with her family, however, on this journey she will be put in I play the line between life and death.

name: Joe Millionaire
summary:
Joe Millionaire is an American reality dating show that premiered on Fox in 2003. The first two seasons of the series followed a group of single women, competing for the affection of a bachelor who was falsely billed as being a millionaire. If the last remaining woman still accepted the love of the bachelor despite the ruse, the couple would also win a high-value prize.

The first season of Joe Millionaire premiered on January 6, 2003. The series was highly successful, with Fox promoting that its season finale (seen by an average of 34.6 million viewers) was the highest-rated entertainment program (excluding Super Bowl lead-out programs) aired on network television since 2000.

name: Pillow Talk
summary: The series revolves around four couples, and one set of roommates, of varying ages and backgrounds. With a realistic tone, the dramatic comedy explores in a raw and unexpected way the drama and hilarity experienced by couples in the intimacy of the bedroom.

name: The Walter Winchell File
summary: Crime stories that Walter Winchell had covered while working with the New York City Police Department.

name: L'Île aux trente cercueils
summary: Christine shares a happy life with her husband Raphaël until the day she receives a mysterious video: images of her childbirth fifteen years earlier, on the island of Sarek, where her son was stillborn. Now haunted by the possibility that her son is alive, she returns to this island to investigate. Based on the novel by Maurice Leblanc.

name: Andy and the Band
summary: Andy and the Band risk missing their next gig by taking on super-weird odd jobs for their fans.  A madcap mix of songs, slapstick and silliness.

previousepisode.name: The Battle of the Bands: Part 2

name: Million Dollar Wheels
summary: What do Jeff Bezos, Jamie Foxx and the most baller orthodontist in Beverly Hills have in common? They're all DM'ing celebrity car dealer RD Whittington. This is a behind-the-scenes look at how he connects the ultra-rich with their million-dollar toys.

name: Marcus Wareing's Tales from a Kitchen Garden
summary: Marcus Wareing steps back from his hectic schedule to spend more time expanding his smallholding in East Sussex with the help from the country's very best British producers.

name: The Pennines: Backbone of Britain
summary: From Derbyshire to the Scottish Borders, we explore the magnificent upland range of the Pennines and meet the people who call its mountains, fells, hills and valleys their home.

name: The Flatshare
summary: The Flatshare follows Tiffany and Leon, two cash-strapped London twentysomethings who share a bed. The catch is – Tiffany and Leon have never met and, if their plan works out, they never will.

name: Bodies
summary: Four detectives. Four timelines. One body. To save Britain's future, they'll need to solve the murder that altered the course of history first. Stephen Graham stars in this time-hopping crime drama inspired by Si Spencer's graphic novel.

previousepisode.name: Heike Kamerlingh Onnes - Het cryogene lab-experiment

name: Portrait Robot
summary: Eve Garance is a remarkable sketch artist capable of "reading" people. In the Investigation Unit of the Police Department, she uses her talents to create composite sketches to catch criminals. Her colleagues include Maryse Ferron, the methodical director whose disability has never stopped her; Bernard Dupin, the seasoned investigator who keeps the dark regions of his life under wraps, and Anthony Kamal, the new technician who doesn't know what he is getting into. This is the team assigned to solve a laundry list of sordid crimes. They will tackle also cold cases - even if old wounds are opened in the process. The return of Eve's ex will force her to reopen a very personal cold case: that of the disappearance of their son William, then six months old. For five years, Eve has been secretly imagining and sketching the faces that her son could have today in the hope of finding him one day.

name: Hodejegerne – Den første løgnen
summary: The place is Oslo, the year is 2002, and Roger Brown is a newly employed headhunter in an exclusive recruitment agency. He is given the prestigious task of finding a new top manager for the oil company Njord Oil. Roger is willing to do whatever it takes to quickly climb the career ladder.

name: Survivre à ses enfants
summary: Becoming parents has not broken the ties that unite Nadine, Kamyar, Annie, Philippe and Josée. On the contrary, it is the humor and the frankness that allows this long-standing friendship that allows them to - survive their children.

name: Titans: The Rise of Wall Street
summary: Money made America a global empire, and for the last century America's riches have been controlled by the titans of Wall Street. J.P. Morgan; Teddy Roosevelt: Henry Goldman & Samuel Sachs; Joe Kennedy; Charles Merrill & Edmund Lynch; Franklin Roosevelt; Ivan Boesky; Michael Milken. Before their names were institutions, they made fortunes, created entire industries and shaped global events. This documentary series exploits world's fascination with Wall Street by fully exploring its stories — its banks, its firms, its CEOs, even its criminals — and, more importantly, how Wall Street works. Each instalment is brought to life with powerful drama, archival footage and gripping sit-downs with the most influential CEOs, investors and traders living today to provide the definitive account of the power, opulence and perilous missteps of American finance.

name: Twisted Metal
summary: Twisted Metal is about a motor-mouthed outsider offered a chance at a better life, but only if he can successfully deliver a mysterious package across a post-apocalyptic wasteland. With the help of a trigger-happy car thief, he faces savage marauders driving vehicles of destruction and other dangers of the open road, including a deranged clown who drives an all too familiar ice cream truck.

name: Something Bit Me!
summary: Something Bit Me! explores the true stories of animal and insect attacks as well as bites and stings that have resulted in sending people to the E.R.

name: The Rogues
summary: The Rogues follows the adventures of the Fleming-St. Clairs, an upper class family of con artists who always do the right in the end.

name: South Americas Weirdest Animals
summary: South America's Weirdest Animals dives into the depths of the South American wild to investigate the cast of misfits, the oddities, the weird, the eccentric and the truly bizarre. The landscape here is truly one of a kind. So, the animals have evolved accordingly. In the South American wild, strange problems gave rise to even stranger solutions.

name: Faten Amal Harby
summary: Faten's decision to get a divorce soon drags her into a struggle to change a law that may deprive her of her rights and children if she remarries.

name: El Meshwar
summary: Two restless labourers find themselves facing larger-than-life challenges amid falling in love and rising from lower rungs.

name: Ahlam Saeida
summary: Brought together by fate, three insomniac middle-aged women go on a journey that helps them overcome their personal challenges and lead more satisfying lives.
